title: Delta Review Engineering Specification — Review Only What Changed, Inherit the Rest
authority: Derived from S200 Delta Review Feasibility Study and S201 Delta Review Architecture. Implements Framework v2 §DELTA_REVIEW and §AUTOMATED_INHERITANCE.
parent_findings: S200: 80% of items unchanged between certification waves, yet every wave re-audits all items
S200: 77% time savings potential via delta review — typical 150-item wave drops from 7.5 hours to 1.7 hours
S201: S809→S810.1 chain — 4 sessions, 60 agent-spawns, 0 pack-file writes, 1 genuinely new finding
S200: 6.2:1 peak duplication ratio — same 38 items examined 56 times across 4 sessions
S200: 75% of audits per item were redundant after initial certification (S318 evidence)
DL-019: Concurrent-write overwrites silently undid 432 items of DL-008 remediation
PHASE0B: 81% of Certified items (707/873) lack primary ledger verification evidence

hash_computation_specification.description: Each item's certification-relevant fields are hashed using SHA-256 to produce a content-addressable fingerprint. The hash serves as the delta comparison baseline — any field change produces a different hash.
hash_computation_specification.hash_collision_probability: << 10^-70 (SHA-256 has 2^256 output space; content strings are <5KB per item)

content_hash_input_fields.description: All learner-facing fields that, if changed, invalidate the prior certification. These fields define the item's content identity for delta-review purposes.

fields.normalization: Trim leading/trailing whitespace. Collapse multiple consecutive spaces to single space. Preserve internal newlines converted to spaces.
fields.rationale: The stem defines the question being asked. Any change to the question text invalidates prior audit.

fields.normalization: Trim whitespace. Collapse multiple spaces to single space.
fields.rationale: Learner-facing answer choice text. Changes invalidate distractor analysis.

fields.normalization: Trim whitespace. Collapse multiple spaces to single space.
Trim whitespace. Collapse multiple spaces to single space.
Trim whitespace. Collapse multiple spaces to single space.
Trim whitespace. Uppercase. Must be single letter A-D.
fields.rationale: Answer-key change is the highest-risk modification. DL-030: 5 Certified items had wrong CC.

fields.normalization: Trim whitespace. Collapse multiple spaces to single space. Collapse multiple newlines to single newline.
fields.rationale: Correct-answer explanation. Changes may reflect editorial improvement or correctness fix.

fields.normalization: Trim whitespace. Collapse multiple spaces to single space.
fields.rationale: Distractor explanation. Changes may reflect DL-008/DL-013/DL-026 remediation.

fields.normalization: Trim whitespace. Collapse multiple spaces to single space.
Trim whitespace. Collapse multiple spaces to single space.
Trim whitespace. Collapse multiple spaces to single space.

excluded_fields: QuestionID — identity field, must not change
question_state — governance state transitions do not affect content
Difficulty / DifficultyScore — hashed separately in metadata_hash
LOSTag / Topic / MicroTopic / UniqueConceptKey — metadata fields

canonical_serialization_format.description: To ensure deterministic hash output, fields are serialized into a canonical JSON format before hashing.
rules: Object keys are sorted alphabetically (A, B, C-Z)
String values are whitespace-normalized per field rules above
canonical_serialization_format.example_canonical_form:
{
  "Choices": {
    "A": "increase by $540,000",
    "B": "decrease by $540,000",
    "C": "remain unchanged",
    "D": "increase by $600,000"
  },
  "CorrectChoice": "A",
  "ExplanationCorrect": "The total cash collections equal cash sales plus credit sales collected in the period. Cash sales: $600,000 × 20% = $120,000. January credit sales collected in January: ($600,000 × 80%) × 50% = $240,000. December credit sales collected in January: ($500,000 × 80%) × 45% = $180,000. Total = $120,000 + $240,000 + $180,000 = $540,000.",
  "ExplanationWrongA": "",
  "ExplanationWrongB": "Option B incorrectly assumes cash decreases. The cash collections calculations show a net increase of $540,000 for January, not a decrease. This misconception may arise from focusing on the credit sales figure without accounting for the collection timing pattern.",
  "ExplanationWrongC": "Option C incorrectly assumes cash remains unchanged. The January cash collections of $540,000 represent a significant change from December's cash position, driven by the collection of prior-period credit sales.",
  "ExplanationWrongD": "Option D incorrectly uses total sales instead of applying the collection percentages. The $600,000 figure is total January sales (cash + credit), not total cash collections. Only 20% of sales are cash; the remaining 80% are collected over two months.",
  "Stem": "Harbor Medical Supplies estimates that 20% of monthly sales are cash transactions and the remaining 80% are credit sales. Credit sales are collected 50% in the month of sale and 45% in the following month. January budgeted sales are $600,000 and December actual sales were $500,000. Assuming no other cash inflows, what is the effect of cash collections on Harbor's cash balance for January?"
}

metadata_hash_input_fields.description: Separate SHA-256 hash for metadata fields that affect psychometric quality, blueprint alignment, and governance state but do not affect answer-key correctness.
metadata_hash_input_fields.rationale: Metadata changes (difficulty recalibration, cognitive level reassignment, blueprint remapping) do not affect learner-facing content correctness. They affect psychometric quality and governance reporting. Separate hash allows delta review to route metadata-only changes to a reduced board scope (Psychometric + Certification only, not full Technical + Explanation).

field_hash_manifest.description: Per-field SHA-256 hashes stored alongside the aggregate content_hash. Enables field-level diffing: on content_hash mismatch, compare field_hashes to identify exactly which field(s) changed.
field_hash_manifest.field_diff_resolution: On content_hash mismatch: (1) Compare each field_hash against the stored field_hash from CERTIFICATION_LEDGER.json. (2) Identify which specific field(s) changed. (3) Apply change_propagation_rules based on changed field type. (4) If content_hash differs but ALL field_hashes match → hash computation error — escalate to methodology audit.

change_classification.label: Content Change — Full Review Required
change_classification.trigger: Content hash differs from ledger hash.

full_content_change.trigger: Stem changed OR any Choice text changed OR CorrectChoice changed.
full_content_change.action: Full PreFlight + BoardReview pipeline. All 6 CAQS dimensions + all G-NEW conditions re-verified. Prior certification decision retired.
full_content_change.rationale: A changed stem means the question being asked is different. A changed choice means prior distractor analysis is invalidated. CorrectChoice change is the highest-risk modification — independent re-derivation required.

explanation_only_change.trigger: Only ExplanationCorrect changed; Stem, Choices, CC unchanged.
explanation_only_change.action: Targeted re-audit on CAQS Dimensions 1 (correctness prong), 3 (technical accuracy), 6 (numerical integrity), 7 (explanation quality). Skip distractor analysis (Dimension 4). Skip blueprint alignment (Dimension 1 blueprint prong).
explanation_only_change.rationale: EC rewrites are common during editorial passes. Answer key unchanged — only explanation text.

ew_only_change.trigger: Only ExplanationWrong fields changed; Stem, Choices, CC, EC unchanged.
ew_only_change.action: Targeted re-audit on CAQS Dimensions 4 (distractor quality), 7 (explanation quality). Skip full re-derivation. Goal: verify new EW text is choice-specific, non-boilerplate, educationally valuable.
ew_only_change.rationale: EW field rewrites are the most common remediation (DL-008 clears, DL-013 boilerplate replacement, DL-026 empty-slot fills). Forcing full re-audit for EW-only changes caused the bulk of redundant audit cycles in S318.

ec_plus_ew_change.trigger: Only ExplanationCorrect AND ExplanationWrong fields changed; Stem, Choices, CC unchanged.
ec_plus_ew_change.action: Combined targeted re-audit on CAQS Dimensions 3, 4, 6, 7. Verify accounting accuracy, numerical integrity, distractor quality, explanation quality.
ec_plus_ew_change.rationale: Combined explanation rewrite — likely comprehensive editorial pass or DL-013 remediation. The question itself hasn't changed.

explanation_only_change: Quality Board B — Dimensions 4 only (if EC change affects distractor reasoning)

change_classification.frequency_estimate: ~15% of all write sessions. ~50-150 items per wave.
examples_from_history: DL-030 answer-key fixes (5 items: P1B-B-119, P1B-F-084/116/121, P1E-E-037)
DL-025 EW distractor authoring (51 Pack A Section D items)

change_classification.label: Metadata Change — Partial Review Required
change_classification.trigger: Content hash matches ledger hash BUT metadata hash differs.
change_classification.action: Partial review on affected dimensions only. Route to Psychometric/Difficulty Calibration board + Certification Board (metadata adjudication). Technical content is unchanged — skip Technical and Explanation quality boards.
change_classification.frequency_estimate: ~10% of all write sessions. ~50-500 items per wave (batch state transitions are most common write operation).
examples_from_history: question_state transitions: Unprocessed → Certified (thousands of items across S13-S18 batch waves)
Difficulty recalibration: DL-031 ~500 items from Moderate→Easy
CognitiveLevel reassignment: 19/38 seeds overstated (rotation template pattern)
AccountingPrinciple field addition (absent from all 38 Domain E seeds)

change_classification.label: Structural Fix — Verification Only, Skip Full Review
change_classification.trigger: Content hash unchanged. Structural field change detected (field presence/absence, empty→filled, corruption repair). No content semantics changed.
change_classification.action: Automated verification only. Re-run the specific defect scan that the fix targeted. Spot-check 10% of fixed items via raw-file line-level inspection. Verify QuestionID count unchanged. If all checks pass, no board review needed.
affected_fields: ExplanationWrong fields (clearing to '' for DL-008, filling empty for DL-026)
question_state field presence (DL-024: adding missing field)
JSON structure (DL-017: backtick-newline artifact; DL-020: brace-matcher fix)
verification_steps: 1. Re-run the specific defect scan that the fix targeted
2. Spot-check 10% of fixed items via direct raw-file line-level inspection
3. Verify QuestionID count unchanged (grep -c '"QuestionID"' before and after)
5. Log fix in REVISION_HISTORY.md. No board review needed.
change_classification.escalation_rule: If automated scan finds ANY residual structural defect or new defect introduced → escalate to CONTENT_CHANGED classification (full review required on affected items).
change_classification.frequency_estimate: ~15% of write sessions (but decreasing — most structural defects are now resolved). 0-50 items per wave.
examples_from_history: DL-008 EW[CC] clearing: 539 occurrences, 22 scan events
DL-018 missing EW[CC] field: 351 items, Pack E + Pack A Section E
DL-017 backtick-newline fix: 275 sites, Pack B
DL-024 missing question_state: 150 items, Pack B Sections A/D
DL-027 closing-tag removal: 15 items (replaceAll, no content loss)

change_classification.label: No Change — Auto-Inherit Prior Certification
change_classification.trigger: Content hash matches ledger hash AND metadata hash matches ledger metadata hash AND all pre-flight scans re-verify PASS AND no governance standard version bump affecting this item AND item's primary_ledger_complete === true (item has been independently verified at least once).
change_classification.action: Item transitions ReadyForBoard → CertifiedDelta. question_state set to 'Certified'. No board review required. Session Pre-Flight Report logs: 'INHERITED — no changes detected.'
change_classification.verification_only: Pre-flight hash match confirmation logged in session governance attestation.
change_classification.estimated_effort: 0 minutes — skip entirely (hash comparison is ~1ms per item, fully automated).
change_classification.frequency_estimate: ~80% of items in scope per certification wave. ~400 out of 500 in-scope items.
examples_from_history: 80% of items in every certification wave (S200 Agent I finding)
S809→S810.1: 38 Domain E seeds, 0 pack-file writes across 4 sessions (100% unchanged)
Pack B Sections B/C/E/F: untouched since original certification

change_classification.label: New Item — No Ledger Entry, Full Review Required
change_classification.trigger: No entry in CERTIFICATION_LEDGER.json for this QuestionID.
change_classification.action: Full PreFlight + BoardReview pipeline. All 6 CAQS dimensions + all G-NEW conditions must be verified. New ledger entry created on certification.
change_classification.frequency_estimate: ~2% of items per wave (new item insertion batches of 10 items each).
examples_from_history: First-time certification of Domain E/F items

inheritance_rules.name: Hash-Match Auto-Inheritance

all_of: Item content hash matches last-certified hash in CERTIFICATION_LEDGER.json
Item metadata hash matches last-certified metadata hash in CERTIFICATION_LEDGER.json
Item's primary_ledger_complete === true (item has been independently verified at least once)
All 11 pre-flight scans re-verify PASS on current file state (Gates -1 through 4)
No governance standard version bump affecting this item's dimensions
No dependency change (exhibit modified, formula reference updated)

inheritance_rules.action: Item transitions ReadyForBoard → CertifiedDelta. question_state set to 'Certified'. Delta status logged as UNCHANGED. No board review required. No agent involvement.
inheritance_rules.governance: Governance Agent verifies CertifiedDelta count. Release Agent updates CURRENT_BASELINES.md per-item hash entry. REVISION_HISTORY.md entry: 'Delta inheritance — N items re-certified without board review (content hash matches Sxxx baseline).'
inheritance_rules.frequency: ~80% of items in a typical wave.

inheritance_rules.name: Dependency-Change Partial Re-Review

all_of: Item content hash matches ledger hash (content unchanged)
Item's dependencies have changed: exhibit modified, formula reference updated, standard citation updated
OR governance standard version bump affects a subset of item dimensions

inheritance_rules.action: Item transitions ReadyForBoard → BoardReview on AFFECTED DIMENSIONS ONLY. If dependency is an exhibit containing calculation data: Board reviews Technical (Dim 3) + Numerical (Dim 6) dimensions. If dependency is a standard reference update: Board reviews Technical (Dim 3) only. Unaffected dimensions inherit prior PASS scores from CERTIFICATION_LEDGER.json.
inheritance_rules.governance: Board Decision Record documents which dimensions were re-reviewed and which were inherited. Prior dimension scores preserved for inherited dimensions.
inheritance_rules.frequency: ~5% of items in a typical wave.

inheritance_rules.name: Hash-Mismatch Full Review

any_of: Item content hash does NOT match ledger hash

inheritance_rules.action: Full PreFlight + BoardReview pipeline. All 6 CAQS dimensions + all G-NEW conditions re-verified. Prior certification decision retired. New certification decision replaces it in CERTIFICATION_LEDGER.json.
inheritance_rules.governance: Item transitions recorded in REVISION_HISTORY.md. Prior ledger entry preserved with superseded annotation (date + session of supersession). New ledger entry created with updated hash and board scores.
inheritance_rules.frequency: ~15-20% of items in a typical wave.

inheritance_rules.name: Governance-Update Bulk Re-Scan

any_of: Governance guard rules changed (new rule added, existing rule criteria modified)

inheritance_rules.action: Item transitions Certified → PreFlight. All affected dimensions re-scanned. If pre-flight PASS + hash match → CertifiedDelta (auto-inherit). If pre-flight FAIL on new rule checks → BoardReview on affected dimensions. If pre-flight PASS + metadata hash mismatch (DCS bump) → metadata-only BoardReview.
inheritance_rules.governance: Session Arbiter triggers bulk re-scan of ALL affected Certified items. CERTIFICATION_LEDGER.json records governance_version at certification time. Version mismatch triggers this rule. Bulk scan results logged to REVISION_HISTORY.md with affected item count.

inheritance_rules.name: Cross-Pack Rotation Hold

all_of: DL-016 pattern detected: metadata-block ChoiceA-D differs from content-block Choices.A-D
Difference is beyond trivial whitespace/case normalization

inheritance_rules.action: Item transitions Certified → Hold. Quarantined from learner pool (GOV-001 fix: Hold items hard-excluded from delivery). Board review required to classify: (a) metadata-only shift — ExplanationWrong fields are static but metadata choices are stale (cosmetic, EW text may still be correct for content-block choices), or (b) true answer-key rotation — CorrectChoice itself is wrong and EW text describes neighbor item's distractors. Classification determines BoardReview scope.
inheritance_rules.governance: Governance Agent manages Hold queue. Hold must be time-bounded (resolution target: 2 sessions). DEFECT_LIBRARY.md entry for new DL-016 instances. Hold items excluded from CertifiedDelta auto-inheritance until resolved.
inheritance_rules.frequency: ~5-10 items per DL-016 discovery wave. Section-wide when new DL-016 surface area discovered.

certification_ledger_schema.description: CERTIFICATION_LEDGER.json is the authoritative record of every item's certification history. Stored in knowledge/ directory. One entry per item per certification event (superseded entries preserved with superseded annotation).

entry_fields.description: Unique question identifier. Matches item's QuestionID field in pack file.
Compound key per SESSION201_IDENTITY_ARCHITECTURE.json: { QID, CorrectChoice, EW_Pattern, Template_Family, File_Path }. Ensures ledger entry refers to the correct item variant.
SHA-256 hash of canonical JSON serialization of content fields (Stem, Choices.A-D, CorrectChoice, ExplanationCorrect, ExplanationWrongA-D).
SHA-256 hash of canonical JSON serialization of metadata fields (Difficulty, DifficultyScore, CognitiveLevel, LOSTag, Topic, AccountingPrinciple, PrimaryCompetency).

Per-field SHA-256 hashes for field-level diffing: { stem_hash, choices_A_hash, choices_B_hash, choices_C_hash, choices_D_hash, correct_choice_hash, explanation_correct_hash, explanation_wrong_A_hash, explanation_wrong_B_hash, explanation_wrong_C_hash, explanation_wrong_D_hash }.
Date of certification. Set on transition to Certified state. Cleared on transition out of Certified.

Monotonically incrementing certification version number. Starts at 1 on initial certification. Increments on each re-certification (IR-003). Does NOT increment on CertifiedDelta auto-inheritance (IR-001).
Session identifier of the board that certified this item. e.g., 'S808', 'S815'.

CAQS §1.6 six-dimension scores at time of certification: { dimension_1_correctness: score, dimension_2_precision: score, dimension_3_difficulty: score, dimension_4_distractor: score, dimension_5_blueprint: score, dimension_6_cma_relevance: score }. Plus G-NEW certification-blocking condition statuses.
Content hash of the immediately prior certification version. Null if this is the first certification. Enables hash-chain verification for audit trail integrity.
Chain of all prior certification versions: [{ version: 1, content_hash: '...', certified_date: '...', board_session: '...' }, ...]. Superseded entries preserved for full audit trail.
Governance standard version at time of certification (e.g., 'CAQS_v1.0', 'QMDS_v1.1'). Used by IR-004 to detect version bumps requiring re-scan.

Whether this item has been independently verified at least once (full CAQS §1.6 six-dimension verification completed). Set to false initially. Set to true after first full verification pass. Delta-review skips unchanged items ONLY IF this is true (IR-001 precondition). Prevents permanent skip of never-verified items.

List of re-audit triggers that have been applied to this item since last certification: e.g., ['content_hash_change', 'governance_bump_v1.1', 'dependency_exhibit_modified']. Used for audit trail and re-audit frequency analysis.

Whether this ledger entry has been superseded by a newer certification event. Default: false. Set to true when a new entry is created with a higher certification_version. Superseded entries preserved for audit trail.
Date this entry was superseded. Null if entry is current.
Session that superseded this entry. Null if entry is current.

reaudit_triggers.priority: IMMEDIATE — item cannot remain Certified with changed content

reaudit_triggers.dimensions_affected: Technical (Dim 3), Numerical (Dim 6) — if exhibit contains calculation data
reaudit_triggers.delta_classification: STRUCTURE_ONLY → escalated to partial BoardReview per IR-002
STRUCTURE_ONLY → escalated to partial BoardReview per IR-002

reaudit_triggers.dimensions_affected: Technical (Dim 3) — verify explanation still cites correct standard
reaudit_triggers.delta_classification: STRUCTURE_ONLY → escalated to partial BoardReview per IR-002

reaudit_triggers.trigger: Governance guard new rule or rule change
reaudit_triggers.dimensions_affected: Depends on rule: Rule 2 change → Explanation (Dim 7), Rule 4 change → Technical (Dim 3)

reaudit_triggers.delta_classification: METADATA_CHANGED → partial BoardReview on psychometric dimensions

reaudit_triggers.dimensions_affected: Explanation (Dim 7), Distractor (Dim 4) — metadata-content mismatch affects learner feedback
reaudit_triggers.priority: HIGH — learner-safety risk (learners see wrong-topic explanations)
reaudit_triggers.delta_classification: CONTENT_CHANGED → escalated to Hold per IR-005

reaudit_triggers.priority: CRITICAL — hash algorithm must be verified. Switch to SHA-512 if collisions found.
reaudit_triggers.delta_classification: Methodology escalation — halt delta review, full pool re-audit

reaudit_triggers.trigger: Concurrent-write overwrite detected (pack file hash changed outside session scope)
reaudit_triggers.priority: CRITICAL — delta ledger may be stale for affected items
reaudit_triggers.delta_classification: Methodology escalation — re-hash entire affected pack, compare to ledger, re-route changed items

delta_comparison_protocol.description: Step-by-step procedure executed by the Session Arbiter at session startup (T0 checkpoint per AGENTS.md §13.1) to determine which items need which level of review.

steps.name: File-Level Integrity Verification
steps.action: Compute SHA-256 hash of each target pack file (pack_a through pack_e_corrected.js). Compare to CURRENT_BASELINES.md pack-level hashes from prior session closeout. If pack hash matches → all 500 items in that pack are file-level unchanged. If pack hash differs → items in this pack MAY have changed (or may be victims of concurrent-write noise).

steps.name: Extract All QuestionIDs from Target Packs
steps.action: For packs with file_hash MISMATCH, run boundary-aware Function constructor parse (AM-1) to extract all QuestionID-bounded objects. Count = expected count (500 per pack). Verify parse success (all objects extract cleanly).
steps.output: Per-item parsed object array + QuestionID list
steps.runtime: ~3s per pack (Function constructor parse + object extraction)

steps.name: Compute Current Content Hashes
steps.action: For each extracted item, compute SHA-256 content hash via canonical JSON serialization of content fields. Also compute metadata hash via canonical JSON serialization of metadata fields. Also compute field_hash manifest (per-field hashes).
steps.runtime: ~1ms per item (SHA-256 of ~2KB canonical JSON) × 500 items = ~0.5s per pack

steps.name: Look Up Ledger Entries
steps.action: For each QuestionID, query CERTIFICATION_LEDGER.json for the most recent non-superseded entry. If found: extract stored content_hash, metadata_hash, field_hashes, certified_date, board_session, primary_ledger_complete, governance_version. If not found: item is NEW_ITEM.
steps.output: Per-item ledger lookup result: FOUND (with entry data) | NOT_FOUND
steps.runtime: ~0.1ms per item (key-value lookup in pre-loaded JSON) × 2,500 items = ~0.25s

steps.name: Classify Each Item
steps.action: Apply change_classification rules to each item: (a) If no ledger entry → NEW_ITEM. (b) If content_hash matches ledger AND metadata_hash matches AND primary_ledger_complete === true AND no governance standard bump → UNCHANGED. (c) If content_hash matches but metadata_hash differs → METADATA_CHANGED. (d) If content_hash differs → CONTENT_CHANGED (and apply sub-classification via field_hash manifest comparison). (e) If content_hash matches but structural scan finds defect on re-verification → STRUCTURE_ONLY (conservative override).
steps.output: Per-item delta_classification with sub-classification detail (changed fields list for CONTENT_CHANGED).

steps.name: Apply Inheritance Rules
steps.action: For each UNCHANGED item, verify IR-001 preconditions: (a) item's ledger state is 'Certified', (b) primary_ledger_complete === true, (c) no dependency change (cross-reference item's dependencies against change log since last certification), (d) no governance standard version bump affecting this item. If all conditions met → auto-inherit: set delta_status to CertifiedDelta. If any condition not met → re-classify to appropriate change class (STRUCTURE_ONLY or CONTENT_CHANGED per IR-002/IR-003/IR-004).
steps.output: Per-item inherited_status: INHERITED | REVIEW_REQUIRED. QID list of auto-inherited items.
steps.runtime: ~0.5ms per item × check for dependency changes (requires dependency graph lookup) × 2,500 items = ~1.25s

steps.name: Generate Delta Inventory
steps.action: Produce the delta inventory: list of items to review grouped by change classification. Compute: total items processed, items skipped (UNCHANGED/auto-inherited), items to review (CONTENT_CHANGED + METADATA_CHANGED + NEW_ITEM), items needing verification only (STRUCTURE_ONLY). Compile per-change-class QID lists for board allocation.
steps.output: Delta inventory: { UNCHANGED: [QIDs], CONTENT_CHANGED: [QIDs], METADATA_CHANGED: [QIDs], STRUCTURE_ONLY: [QIDs], NEW_ITEM: [QIDs], auto_inherited_count: N, review_required_count: N }

steps.name: Integrate with Pre-Flight Pipeline
steps.action: Feed delta inventory into the readiness gate pipeline (SESSION202_READINESS_GATE_ENGINEERING.json). UNCHANGED items skip pre-flight except for hash verification (Gate 0 PF-008 hash stability check). All other items enter full pre-flight pipeline (Gates -1 through 4). Pre-flight results merged with delta classification to produce final readiness classification (READY, MINOR_FIX, REMEDIATE, BLOCKED).
steps.output: Final readiness classification per item + board-filtered inventory.
steps.runtime: See SESSION202_READINESS_GATE_ENGINEERING.json pipeline runtime (~104s/pack, optimized to ~60-90s with parallelism)

steps.name: Tend Reconciliation
steps.action: At session close (Tend checkpoint per AGENTS.md §13.1), re-hash ALL items in packs that were written to during the session. Compare post-session hashes to pre-session delta inventory. Any item whose hash changed but was NOT in the 'review_required' delta inventory → flag as CONCURRENT_WRITE or METHODOLOGY_ERROR. Escalate per RT-011.

delta_comparison_protocol.total_protocol_runtime: ~10-15 seconds for delta detection on all 5 packs (steps 1-7). Plus ~90 seconds for full pre-flight pipeline on changed items (step 8). Plus ~15 seconds for Tend reconciliation (step 9). Total: ~2 minutes for a full 5-pack delta + pre-flight pipeline startup.

delta_ledger_maintenance.description: CERTIFICATION_LEDGER.json is updated after every certification session. Only items that were reviewed and certified get their hashes updated. Unchanged items retain their prior hash.

update_rules.action: Create new ledger entry with certification_version: 1, prior_version_hash: null, primary_ledger_complete: true, all board dimension scores recorded.

Supersede prior entry (set superseded: true, superseded_date, superseded_by_session). Create new entry with certification_version = prior_version + 1, prior_version_hash = prior content_hash, updated board dimension scores. Append prior version to certification_version_chain.

Update metadata_hash and metadata-related board dimension scores (Difficulty, Cognitive Level, Blueprint). Content hash, content-related board scores, and certification_version remain unchanged. Add 'metadata_change' to reaudit_triggers_applied.
No ledger change. Item's existing ledger entry remains current. Session Pre-Flight Report logs inheritance event.

update_rules.event: Structural fix (STRUCTURE_ONLY → no state change, item was already Certified)
update_rules.action: No ledger change. Structural fix does not create a new certification event. REVISION_HISTORY.md logs the fix.

ledger_seeding.description: Initial population of CERTIFICATION_LEDGER.json for all 2,500 items using current pack file state as baseline (Phase 1 of Delta Review implementation).
procedure: 1. Run boundary-aware Function constructor parse on all 5 packs
2. For each item, compute content_hash + metadata_hash + field_hashes

3. For currently Certified items (question_state: 'Certified'): create ledger entry with certification_version: 1, primary_ledger_complete: false (unless independently verified via PHASE0B), board_dimension_scores: null (to be backfilled from board records)
4. For non-Certified items: create ledger placeholder with content_hash but certification_version: 0, certified_date: null, primary_ledger_complete: false
5. Independent verification: re-extract and re-hash all 2,500 items using a SECOND independent extraction pass. 0 mismatches required.
6. Cross-validate: for 5% random sample, manually extract fields from raw file and confirm hash matches computed hash
7. Store CERTIFICATION_LEDGER.json in knowledge/ directory. Record methodology version (AM-1) and date.
ledger_seeding.estimated_effort: 1 session (~2 hours, 2 agents: hasher builder + verifier)

risks.title: False Negative — Changed Item Not Detected
risks.description: Item content changes but hash does not change because the change was in a non-hashed field or the hash extraction methodology produced an identical hash for different content.
mitigations: Content hash covers ALL learner-facing fields (Stem, Choices, CC, EC, EW). Any meaningful content change detectable by a human reviewer is also detectable by hash comparison.
Structural defect detection is separate: automated pre-flight scanners catch DL-008/026/018 even on hash-matching items. Conservative override: if scanner finds defect, escalate.
Metadata hash (separate) catches Difficulty/CognitiveLevel/LOSTag changes independently.
SHA-256 collision for strings <5KB is effectively impossible (2^256 output space).
10% spot-check re-hash at session startup; 5% cross-wave re-hash at Tend.

risks.title: Inherited Defect — Undetected Defect in Prior Certification
risks.description: An item was certified with a latent defect (e.g., DL-030 answer-key error) that was missed by the certifying board. Delta review skips this item because its hash hasn't changed, perpetuating the latent defect.
mitigations: This risk already exists in the current system — it is not introduced by delta review. Same boards that missed the defect would miss it under either system.
Defect sweeps (DL-008, DL-030, DL-010) scan entire Certified pool regardless of when items were certified — independent of delta review.
Pre-delivery safety check filters learner pool against known-defective QID list.
Periodic deep-sampling: every 10th session, randomly select 5% of 'no_change' items for full 6-dimension CAQS verification.
primary_ledger_complete gate (IR-001 precondition) prevents inheritance on never-verified items (closes the PHASE0B 81% verification gap).

risks.title: Hash Methodology Drift — Different Tools Produce Different Hashes
risks.description: Hash extraction methodology differs between the tool that wrote the stored hash and the tool that re-computes it. Different whitespace handling, key ordering, or field extraction boundaries produce different hashes for unchanged items.
mitigations: Canonical JSON serialization standard: sorted keys, no trailing commas, consistent whitespace normalization.
Use AM-1 boundary-aware Function constructor parser for all hash extraction — single methodology mandated.
Pre-write hash and post-read hash use identical extraction code (same Node.js script, same parameters).
Store the parser methodology version (AM-1) in CERTIFICATION_LEDGER.json alongside each hash.
If hash mismatch rate exceeds 5% of items claimed 'unchanged', trigger methodology audit.

risks.title: Concurrent-Write Overwrite — Hash Becomes Stale
risks.description: Concurrent session modifies items while current session is computing pre-flight hashes. Items have changed but hashes reflect stale state.
mitigations: Session-registry file: before computing pre-flight hashes, lock the pack files (write .lock file). Concurrent sessions detect lock and delay.
Post-remediation reconciliation (step 9 of delta comparison protocol): re-hash ALL items after writes, compare to pre-flight delta inventory.
Exclusive session model (recommended): only ONE session at a time operates on any given pack file.
If exclusive model is impractical: pre-write hash computed immediately before write, post-write hash computed immediately after write.

risks.title: Re-review Scope Creep — Verification Requirements Erode Savings
risks.description: To mitigate DR-001 through DR-004, verification requirements grow until delta review provides negligible savings over full re-review.
mitigations: Verification proportionate to risk: 5-10% spot-check for 'no_change' items. 100% hash re-computation is automated and negligible (<1s per 500 items).
If false-positive hash mismatch rate exceeds 2% → methodology bug, fix methodology.
Calibration rule: verification sampling rate = MAX(5%, 2 × false_positive_rate). Hard cap: 15%.
Track delta review efficiency metrics (actual savings vs. projected) and adjust sampling rate based on historical FP rate.

risks_and_mitigations.overall_risk_profile: LOW-MEDIUM. Primary risks (DR-001, DR-004) are mitigated by conservative overrides and concurrent-session locking. DR-002 (inherited defects) is NOT a new risk — it exists in the current system independently. DR-003 (hash drift) is the highest-likelihood operational risk but is mechanical and fixable.

phase_0.name: Prerequisite — DL-019 File-Lock Protocol
phase_0.description: Implement file-lock protocol and session-registry before any delta-review infrastructure. Without write-coordination, content hashes are untrustworthy.
deliverables: .lock file protocol per pack file
Session-registry tracking active write sessions per pack
Pre-write snapshot verification (file hash must match expected baseline before write)

phase_1.name: Hash Infrastructure & Delta Ledger
phase_1.description: Define canonical serialization format, compute and store content hashes on all 2,500 items, create CERTIFICATION_LEDGER.json.
deliverables: Canonical serialization specification (key order, exclusion list, normalization rules)
content_hash + metadata_hash + field_hashes on all 2,500 items
CERTIFICATION_LEDGER.json seeded for all items
ContentHashValidator module in validator suite
governance-guard Rule 6 updated to require content_hash update on any content edit
Independent dual-extraction hash stability verification (0 mismatches required)

phase_2.name: Per-Item Version + Timestamp Installation
phase_2.description: Add certification_version and certified_date tracking fields. Backfill for all currently Certified items.
deliverables: certification_version field on all items (0 for Unprocessed, >=1 for Certified)
certified_date field on all Certified items (backfilled from REVISION_HISTORY.md)
Governance guard: certification transition sets certified_date

phase_3.name: PHASE0B Primary Ledger Completion
phase_3.description: Complete independent verification of all currently Certified items that lack primary ledger evidence (707 of 873 per PHASE0B). This closes the gap that prevents delta review from auto-inheriting never-verified items.
deliverables: primary_ledger_complete: true on all Certified items
Per-item derivation evidence (formula + substitution + result for numeric; principle citation for conceptual)
CorrectChoice vs. independent derivation reconciliation
phase_3.estimated_sessions: ~10-15 sessions for remaining 707 items (41 batches per PHASE0B plan)

phase_4.name: Delta Review Engine Activation
phase_4.description: Integrate content_hash, field_hashes, and ledger lookup into the session startup protocol. Implement full delta comparison protocol (steps 1-9).
deliverables: Pre-flight delta pre-scan: computes current hashes, compares to ledger, produces delta inventory
Change classifier: maps field_hash changes to change_propagation_rules → audit scope
Skip-log: records every skipped item with content_hash, baseline reference, and timestamp
Dry-run validation: run delta pre-flight alongside full review; compare findings

phase_5.name: Continuous Monitoring & Baseline Recapture
phase_5.description: After each certification wave, recapture content_hash baselines for changed items. Delta review becomes self-maintaining.
deliverables: Per-session baseline update: re-hash only items with changed content
CURRENT_BASELINES.md extended to include per-pack hash + per-section changed-item-count
T0/Tmid/Tend checkpoint integration per AGENTS.md §13.1
Full re-audit scheduler (every 10th session)
phase_5.estimated_sessions: Ongoing — integrated into each certification session startup

implementation_phases.total_to_activation: 16-21 sessions (dominated by Phase 3 PHASE0B primary ledger completion at 10-15 sessions, which is independently valuable regardless of delta review).
